description: This file handles the server-side logic for saving email marketing campaigns within the SuiteCRM platform. It processes form data submitted via POST, manages access control, updates campaign properties, and manages relationships with prospect lists.

classes.name: Bean
classes.description: A generic class representing data entities in SuiteCRM, used here for email marketing campaigns.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the email marketing campaign data to the database, with optional notification handling.
